reigns.note: King of Lemnos before the Lemnian women slew their husbands; Homer still knows the isle as the city of godlike Thoas, and Apollonius makes Hypsipyle spare him alone.
Daughter of Thoas who ruled the women-held island when the Argonauts came; Jason left the sovereignty with her, and she bore him Euneus (and Nebrophonus or Deipylus).
Son of Jason and Hypsipyle; in the Iliad he is the Lemnian lord who ships wine to the Achaeans and pays the ransom when Achilles sells Lycaon into Lemnos.
